## Crash-safe JSONStorage writes (2026-11-02)

The owner reported that a service was OOM-killed mid-write and left a truncated db.json that TinyDB could no longer open. They asked for JSONStorage writes to be crash-safe, so that a crash partway through a write cannot leave a truncated file.

The only recorded work so far is a diagnosis (observation #1). JSONStorage.write overwrites db.json in place, so a crash partway through leaves a half-written file. Memory has no fix, PR, release or owner confirmation yet, so the request is in progress at about 15%.

The work is still at the diagnosis stage, so there is little to learn about rework or stalls. The next step is a fix that avoids in-place overwrites.
